newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine President Kuchma to visit France.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine President Kuchma to visit France.

text.p: Ukrainian President Leonid Kuchma travels to France on Wednesday for a visit aiming to boost political and business ties, a spokesman said on Tuesday.
Kuchma will hold talks with French President Jacques Chirac and Foreign Minister Herve de Charette, as well as other senior government officials during the three-day visit.

Ukraine considers France a lukewarm partner within the G7 group of wealthy nations in terms of financial aid and political backing, and some Kiev diplomats say France is blocking Western aid to close the Chernobyl nuclear power, site of the world's worst nuclear disaster in 1986.
Following his visit to France Kuchma will attend the World Economic Forum in the Swiss Alpine resort of Davos from February 1 to 3.
